subject: reasoning
question: Statements: No apple is orange. Some oranges are bananas. Conclusions: I. Some bananas are not apples. II. No banana is an apple.
solution:
**Statements: **No apple is orange. Some oranges are bananas.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3bfd162274709f0fb8a15f254dee3cdd6969754c340764bf72a245ebc8afe669.png] 

**​****Conclusions:** 

I. Some bananas are not apples. - **True** (Because No apple is orange. Some oranges are bananas, which means some bananas which are oranges are not apples)

II. No banana is an apple. - False (It can be possible, but it is not definite)

So, only Conclusion I follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
